gates.pass_condition: PythonPptxAssembler is the only public deck writer; compiler and template reconstruction cannot export an acceptance deck independently
approved figure input, deterministic native plan, explicit per-feature/object outcome, no silent fallback
synthetic vectors and required acceptance figure families produce structurally auditable native plans or explicitly declared vector fallback
native-fidelity evidence meets CP5-B evidence rules; structural emission alone is insufficient
template/package construction uses only committed sanitized/public/synthetic inputs and no private or prior-deck binary base
required sanitized semantic layout roles and measured shell topology/geometry are reconstructed or all deviations are below release tolerances
Phase 2 H001→H002 order, cursors, scientific bindings, Fishbone history, decisions/actions, notes and provenance remain intact; no H003 is invented
all governed figure placements enter Layout through reverified ApprovedFigureHandle and native plan or explicit vector fallback
OOXML package, relationships, slide/layout/master references, notes, media, object identities and package manifest are valid
all acceptance slides have hash-bound render evidence with required clipping/overflow/margin/nonblank checks
all release-required sanitized professor metrics are within tolerance and no required calibration is insufficient_evidence
every acceptance slide render has hash-bound image-capable review with no critical issue
generated deck completes native PowerPoint open/save/reopen acceptance with required structure/editability preservation
package-part manifest, relationship audit and repository/staged privacy checks show no prohibited private or undeclared package content
every gate marked required_for_production_release is pass; blocked is not pass
production_release_status is pass and external reviewer accepts the release package

aggregation_rules.acceptance_deck_build_status: pass only if every required_for_acceptance_deck_build gate passes
aggregation_rules.production_release_status: pass only if every required_for_production_release gate except RG-15/RG-16 passes
aggregation_rules.production_group_meeting_ready: false until production_release_status passes and external reviewer approval exists
